projects.title: Kindertales - Childcare Management Software
projects.summary: All-in-one childcare management software for preschools and daycare centers.
projects.description: Kindertales is a comprehensive childcare management platform designed for multi-location providers. Features include versatile online billing, powerful center management, streamlined parent communication, waitlist management, attendance tracking, milestones tracking, and integrated CRM. The platform helps childcare centers manage operations, communicate with families and staff, meet licensing requirements, and streamline daily tasks.

projects.title: Construkted - 3D Reality Capture Platform
projects.summary: Share, explore, and understand your 3D capture of reality.
projects.description: Construkted Reality is a platform for sharing, viewing, and exploring 3D captures of real-world locations. Users can upload 3D assets, browse captured locations like the Mexico City Metropolitan Cathedral, Palace of Fine Arts, and various architectural sites. The platform provides tools for 3D visualization, asset management, and collaborative exploration of spatial data.

projects.title: MyAIWiz - AI Tax Document Automation
projects.summary: Convert tax documents to returns in 60 seconds using AI.
projects.description: MyAIWiz is an AI-powered tax document automation platform designed for CPA firms. The system processes tax documents by extracting every field using AI, exports Drake .DI5 and ProSeries import files, and provides structured workpapers. Features include AI tax document organizer, IRS notice copilot, exception flags for missing data, optional licensed CPA review, and audit-ready documentation. Built for 5-100 person firms handling high seasonal volume.

projects.title: Calmerceuticals - Premium Marine Collagen Supplements
projects.summary: Australian-made hydrolysed marine collagen supplements for skin health.
projects.description: Calmerceuticals is an e-commerce platform selling premium marine collagen supplements made in Australia. The product line includes VERISOL® Enhanced Marine Collagen, PeriCalm perimenopause relief supplements, Ultra Performance for men, microbiome-first longevity support, and deep hydrating collagen facemasks. The site features a quiz system, before/after photo reviews, and wholesale B2B login. Clinically proven to reduce wrinkles and boost skin elasticity.

projects.title: Okani Travels - African Flight Booking Platform
projects.summary: Travel booking platform for flights, activities, and hotels across Africa.
projects.description: Okani Travels is a comprehensive travel booking platform focusing on African destinations including Gabon, Cameroon, Benin, Togo, and South Africa. Features include flight booking for domestic, regional, and international routes, city exploration, activity booking, secure payment processing, and trip management. The platform offers exclusive flight deals, multi-step booking process, and WhatsApp customer support. Available in French with routes connecting Libreville to major African and international cities.

projects.title: Shugic - Modern Web Application
projects.description: Shugic is a modern web application built with React.js and create-react-app. The platform features a responsive design with custom typography using Montserrat font. Built as a single-page application with optimized performance and modern UI/UX principles. The application demonstrates expertise in React development, component architecture, and modern web technologies.

experience.description: Collaborate with frontend engineers, backend developers, QA engineers, product managers, and designers to develop enterprise web application features using React, TypeScript, Node.js, and modern web technologies. Develop and maintain reusable React and TypeScript components using Tailwind CSS, improving UI consistency and reducing duplicate frontend development efforts across application modules. Contribute to RESTful API development using Node.js and Express.js, implementing business logic, API integrations, and secure authentication workflows using JWT, OAuth2, and RBAC. Partner with backend and database teams to analyze PostgreSQL performance issues, optimize SQL queries, and improve indexing strategies to enhance application response times. Support cloud-based application environments using AWS services, Docker development workflows, and CI/CD automation through GitHub Actions. Participate in software design discussions, peer code reviews, debugging sessions, Agile ceremonies, and production support activities. Improve application reliability through enhanced validation, error handling, logging, monitoring, and performance optimization practices.

Collaborated with software engineers, QA engineers, designers, and product teams to build and enhance enterprise applications using React, TypeScript, JavaScript, Node.js, and REST APIs. Developed reusable frontend components and application features using React, Redux Toolkit, React Query, and Context API to support scalable and maintainable user interfaces. Contributed to backend service development using Node.js and Express.js, implementing API integrations, business logic, and data processing workflows. Assisted with application modernization efforts by migrating legacy functionality into React and TypeScript-based solutions to improve maintainability and user experience. Supported database optimization initiatives including SQL query improvements, data modeling, indexing strategies, and performance tuning across PostgreSQL and Oracle environments to improve application performance and reliability. Worked with AWS services including EC2, S3, and RDS to support application deployments, testing activities, and cloud-based environments. Improved software quality by contributing to automated testing practices using Jest, React Testing Library, JUnit, and Mockito, increasing test coverage from 75% to 92%. Supported CI/CD processes using GitHub Actions and Jenkins to improve build automation, testing workflows, and deployment reliability. Participated in Agile Scrum activities including sprint planning, backlog refinement, daily stand-ups, retrospectives, and technical collaboration sessions. Contributed to code reviews, troubleshooting, technical documentation, and engineering best practices across development teams.

Collaborated with senior engineers to develop and maintain enterprise identity management applications using JavaScript, React.js, Java, and Spring Boot. Developed frontend UI components, enhanced client-side validation, and resolved user experience issues to improve application usability. Assisted with backend feature development and REST API enhancements supporting enterprise application workflows. Created automated unit tests using JUnit and Mockito to improve code reliability and reduce regression risks across production software releases. Participated in Git-based development workflows including branching, pull requests, code reviews, and version control practices. Supported Agile development processes through sprint activities, debugging sessions, testing, and feature delivery.
